summary: Prompt 13 (SPEED PASS #2 + MEDIA VIEWER + BRAND POLISH) frontend-only verification on mobile Expo web + web dashboard. All measurable acceptance points passed. (A) SPEED — cold_load_to_language_screen = 691 ms, login_to_home_visible = 3309 ms (Home paints with content immediately: 'Hello, Amey Ghadge · 19/07/2026 · Administration · Report Complaint · Attendance · Punch In · My Complaints · Alerts · Approvals'), Home → Complaints (My Reports) tab-switch to first-paint = 101 ms (SWR cache-first), direct navigation to /approvals to skeleton visible = 200 ms (SkeletonRows found within 200 ms of nav), approvals-screen ready = 785 ms. No blank white flash observed on any transition. (B) MEDIA CARD on /incident/5b3ccaa2-1bb6-40aa-8a5a-206432a71124 — [data-testid="incident-media"] rendered with borderRadius=14px, borderWidth=2px, borderColor=rgb(11,79,108) (brand blue), boxShadow present, HogoPlus badge text at bottom-right (top:193, right:10, width:77, height:21), expand pill at top-LEFT (top:10, left:10, size 30x30). Status chip 'Escalated' rendered separately at top-right — NO overlap with the top-left expand pill (measured geometry: pill ends at x=40, chip starts far to the right). Tap on card opened full-screen [data-testid="media-viewer"] with [data-testid="media-viewer-image"] visible, [data-testid="media-viewer-close"] closes cleanly (modal.is_visible=False after close). (C) OTP screen — [data-testid="otp-delay-hint"] rendered with inline eye loader (2 layers eye-base.png + eye-iris.png) and English hint 'The OTP SMS can take 10–15 seconds to arrive'. Marathi landing screen also shows the maroon footer. (D) BRAND-FOOTER (maroon #7A1F2B = rgb(122,31,43)) verified via computed getComputedStyle on: language screen ✓, phone screen ✓, OTP screen ✓, and post-login webdash ✓. Home (tab-bar screen) correctly does NOT render it. (E) WEBDASH (emp 0001 / Hogo@2026Cgm) post-login shows the maroon [data-testid="brand-footer"] band (bg rgb(122,31,43)); the branded eye 'Loading…' animation is visible on the Overview panel; the incident modal / production panel did not populate items before the request timed out during this run (data-dependent — verified only that side-nav renders and footer + eye-loader are healthy). (F) BACK-STACK — Home → Complaints → back returns to Home cleanly, no duplicated screens. (G) VIDEO INCIDENT — none surfaced in Approvals/incidents queue during this run. Per prompt instruction, NOT creating one; noting the media-viewer-video path as UNTESTABLE this iteration (code path in MediaCard.tsx uses expo-video useVideoPlayer + , kind='video' branch rendering a play-poster with rgba(58,93,174,0.9) play circle — code inspection PASS, runtime cannot be exercised without a video-carrying incident). Approvals regs selfies count = 0 and face-compare count = 0 during this run (no pending registrations / no flagged attendance today on production) — MediaViewerModal wiring on Approvals selfies + face_compare rows was verified by code inspection only (Pressable→setViewImg→MediaViewerModal uri=viewImg kind='photo'). No red screen, no React Native runtime errors. Only benign RN-web warnings observed (shadow* deprecation, useNativeDriver JS fallback, props.pointerEvents deprecation).
